links.outcome: Model confidence calibration during incorrect diagnoses (false negatives)
links.effect: Gemini 3 kept high confidence (84.62%) during false-negative predictions; GPT-5 and Grok 4 showed better calibration with a significant confidence drop upon incorrect diagnosis.
links.quote: Notably, Gemini 3 exhibited severe overconfidence, maintaining a high CI (84.62%) even during false-negative predictions, whereas GPT-5 and Grok 4 showed better calibration with a significant drop in confidence upon incorrect diagnosis.

links.outcome: Sensitivity of MLLMs for melanoma screening when used as standalone tools
links.effect: All models missed about half of malignant lesions; Grok 4 sensitivity 52%; Gemini 3 accuracy 71%, specificity 94%.
links.quote: All models exhibited a critical deficit in sensitivity, missing approximately half of the malignant lesions.

screen.reason: Evaluates the diagnostic accuracy and confidence calibration of multimodal LLMs (GPT-5, Gemini 3, Grok 4) on an ISIC image dataset for melanoma screening, without testing an organizational deployment safeguard or practice intervention.
